title: General.
officialText: The transportation, handling, storage, installation, connection, ventilation, and use of all volatile flammable oils, flammable and combustible mixtures, compressed gases, and other hazardous materials shall comply with the New York City Fire Code, and shall also be safeguarded in accordance with the requirements of Section 3307.4.2.
